title: 高温计划 Heat Plan
description:
Decision and StrategyEach turn, decide whether to acquire new units, expand the map, or obtain new beneficial effects. Arrange units in a way that maximizes benefits for each unit without causing negative impacts on others.Roguelite ElementsThere are four main types of units: dwarves, devices, plants, and animals. Each unit has its unique characteristics and production impact. At higher difficulties, disaster units may appear, which create avoidable negative effects.

 

Different buffs: These special global buffs provide a large amount of coins. Choose different units based on the selected buffs.

 Clear Game ObjectiveYour only goal is to earn more coins than the target amount. Strategically place units to achieve this goal, and enjoy the process of thinking and planning.
description_short: Heat Plan is a strategy roguelike game about unit placement. Make good use of randomly appearing units and buffs, and strategically place your units within the limited grid spaces on the board to earn more coins and achieve the set goal.
